description: Publish a static website (HTML, CSS, JS, images) to the Press5 launch pad and get its live URL. Works with no account: without a token the site gets a random name, goes live at once, and the reply has a claim_url for the person to keep it (unclaimed sites are deleted after 3 days) and a site_key to redeploy the same site. With a token, "site" picks the name (3-42 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; created the first time if free). Send every file of the built site; this replaces the whole site. Text files as plain content, binary files as base64 with encoding "base64". Best for small sites: for big builds use the HTTP API with a .tar.gz (see https://my.press5.xyz/llms.txt). To start from one of the free starter templates (list_templates), send "template" and optional "fields" instead of files. Signed in, it also RUNS Node.js apps and Discord bots: send the project source (package.json and code, never node_modules or .env) with runtime "node". The server runs npm install, npm run build if there is a build script, then npm start. A web app (kind "web") must listen on process.env.PORT and is served at https://<site>.on.press5.xyz; a bot (kind "bot", detected from discord.js) gets no web address. The reply is "queued": poll deploy_status until "live" or "failed". Apps start on a free 72-hour trial.

fields.description: With template: the text to fill in, by field key, e.g. {"name": "Rosie's Café", "email": "hi@rosies.example"}.

content.description: File content: text, or base64 when encoding is "base64"

path.description: Path in the site, e.g. index.html or assets/app.js

kind.description: For runtime node: web (an HTTP server on process.env.PORT) or bot (no web address). Detected from the dependencies when left out.

runtime.description: static (default: files served as they are) or node (run a Node.js app or bot; needs a token). Left out, an upload with package.json and no index.html is run as an app.

site.description: Site name, becomes <site>.on.press5.xyz. Needs a token; leave it out for a random name.

site_key.description: The site_key from an earlier deploy without an account, to update that same site.

spa.description: Single-page app: serve index.html for unknown paths (client-side routing)

template.description: Instead of files: the id of a starter template from list_templates, published as it is or with "fields" filled in.

token.description: A press5 token (p5_...). Only needed when the MCP connection has no Authorization header, e.g. right after login_check.

name: deploy_site
title: Deploy a site, app or bot
